benchmark_latency: benchmark the latency of processing a single batch of requests with vLLM
run_latency_benchmark: run a latency benchmark on a vLLM model with configurable input and output lengths
profile_generation: profile the generation process of a single batch using torch or cuda profiler
save_benchmark_results: save latency benchmark results to JSON with average latency and percentiles
add_cli_args: add command-line arguments for configuring vLLM latency benchmark parameters
